title.ja: Phoning「HYEIN DAY」ヘインの初ライブ

summary.ja: 公式アプリPhoningのメンバー別「DAY」企画で、ヘインが初めてのライブ配信を行った。
summary.en: Hyein holds her first live broadcast on the official app Phoning, as part of the member-by-member 'DAY' launch week.

detail.ja: 公式コミュニケーションアプリPhoning（7月25日公開）のメンバー別「DAY」企画の一環として、ヘインが初めてライブ配信を行った。公式Xは当日「Today is HYEIN DAY! Phoningでヘインとベフになろう」と告知。ライブはアプリ内で配信され、後日リプレイが提供される。
detail.en: As part of the member-by-member 'DAY' launch week of Phoning, the official communication app released on July 25, Hyein held her first live broadcast. The official X account announced 'Today is HYEIN DAY!' that morning. Lives stream inside the app, with replays made available later.

editor_note: Date and content from the fan-maintained namu.wiki "NewJeans/Phoning LIVE" log; Phoning replays are app-only and could not be fetched. Not confirmed from an official source. detail.ja: デビュー3周年に合わせ、ADORは「NewJeans Day On-Air」と題して公式SNSで未公開写真を公開した。公式YouTubeチャンネルでは同じ日に「[NewJeans Day] Happy 3rd Anniversary」と「[NewJeans Day] We are NewJeans」の2本が公開された。
detail.en: For the third debut anniversary, ADOR ran 'NewJeans Day On-Air', posting unreleased photos on official SNS. The same day, two videos, '[NewJeans Day] Happy 3rd Anniversary' and '[NewJeans Day] We are NewJeans', went up on the official YouTube channel.

editor_note: TenAsia reported a ~19-hour YouTube stream (850-900 concurrent viewers at 16:00); no stream VOD ID found on the channel, and other outlets describe "On-Air" as an SNS post. Treat the stream claim with caution. / TenAsia reported a roughly 19-hour stream on the official YouTube channel (00:00-19:00 KST; 850-900 concurrent viewers at 16:00); no stream VOD ID was found on the channel and other outlets describe 'On-Air' as an SNS post, so the stream claim is unverified and kept out of reader text.

title.ja: Weverseで「Bunnies Club」利用開始を告知
title.en: ADOR announces 'Bunnies Club' access on Weverse

summary.ja: ADORが公式Xで、公式ファンクラブ兼メンバーシップ「Bunnies Club」をWeverseで利用できるようになったと告知。
summary.en: ADOR announces on the official X account that the Bunnies Club fan club and membership can now be accessed on Weverse.

detail.ja: 公式ファンクラブ兼メンバーシップ「Bunnies Club」が、グローバルファンプラットフォームWeverseで利用できるようになった。ADORがNewJeans公式Xを通じて告知した。前日の22日にはデビュー4周年映像「2026 Summer of NewJeans」が公開され、23日には「4 Years of NewJeans」をテーマにした写真とTikTokショート動画も投稿されている。
detail.en: 'Bunnies Club', the official fan club and membership service, became accessible on the global fan platform Weverse, as ADOR announced through NewJeans' official X account. The fourth-anniversary videos '2026 Summer of NewJeans' had been released the day before, on the 22nd, and '4 Years of NewJeans' photos and short TikTok videos were posted on the 23rd.

editor_note: Nocut News (English) 2026-07-23 article fetched. The X post URL was not retrieved.
